explication: CrossDesk is a cross-platform remote-desktop product: a desktop host/control app and native iOS/Android control clients, with browser access documented in the README. The main workflow is to connect using a device ID and password, establish a remote session, then stream desktop media and send input or collaboration actions. The graph emphasizes documented session capabilities and sampled runtime ownership. Some subsystems are included from README descriptions and the file tree; their internal wiring was not sampled, so those links are omitted or marked unverified.
